# Signifyd: Fraud and Consumer Abuse Protection for Companies

> Protect the entire customer journey with the only decision engine built for login, checkout, returns and appeasements, backed by a guarantee\.

Generated by Yoast SEO v28.8, this is an llms.txt file, meant for consumption by LLMs.

## Pages
- [Holiday Ecommerce Tracker](https://www.signifyd.com/holiday-ecommerce-data-tracker/)
- [PPC Generic Competitor vs\. Signifyd in Ecommerce Fraud Protection](https://www.signifyd.com/fraud-protection-software-market-comparison/)
- [Navigating the returns revolution](https://www.signifyd.com/emea-retail-return-trends/)
- [Auto Parts \& Tire Industry](https://www.signifyd.com/industries/autoparts/)
- [FAQ](https://www.signifyd.com/faq/)

## Posts
- [Holiday return fraud: Common schemes and prevention strategies](https://www.signifyd.com/blog/holiday-return-fraud/)
- [7 Ways to Stop Ecommerce Gift Card Fraud \& Bot Attacks](https://www.signifyd.com/blog/gift-card-fraud-prevention/)
- [Retail Fraud Prevention: 2026 Guide to Stop Ecommerce Losses](https://www.signifyd.com/blog/retail-fraud-prevention/): Learn how retail fraud prevention helps merchants stop abuse, reduce false declines and protect more revenue\.
- [What is Know Your Agent \(KYA\)? AI fraud signals explained](https://www.signifyd.com/blog/know-your-agent/): Learn what Know Your Agent \(KYA\) means for agentic commerce, how to evaluate AI\-driven transactions \& more\.
- [Why Agentic AI? How to Build Trust in the New Commerce Journey](https://www.signifyd.com/blog/why-agentic-ai/): Consumers have adopted agentic commerce for shopping, deal finding and cart building\. Merchants need to prepare for when bots will be buying at a larger scale\. 

## Customers
- [Mack’s Prairie Wings](https://www.signifyd.com/customers/macks-prairie-wings/): Located in Stuttgart, Arkansas, the duck hunting capital of the world, Mack’s Prairie Wings has been outfitting waterfowl hunters since 1944\. With Signifyd’s Guaranteed Fraud Protection automating their order review, Mack’s can scale to seasonal demand while maintaining the quick service their name is built on\.
- [Rad Power Bikes](https://www.signifyd.com/customers/rad-power-bikes/): Rad Power Bikes is changing how we all move around our cities, neighborhoods, and wide open spaces\. Signifyd helps them accept more orders, ship them out faster, and eliminate fraud losses\.
- [Toys R Us](https://www.signifyd.com/customers/toys-r-us/): With over 80 locations across the country, Toys R Us is Canada’s leading toy and baby retailer\. When the pandemic forced the doors closed on physical stores, Signifyd’s guaranteed protection gave the toys specialists the confidence to roll out innovative omnichannel experiences and meet changing consumer demands\.
- [Enjuku Racing](https://www.signifyd.com/customers/enjuku-racing/): Since 1999, Enjuku Racing Parts has supported the aftermarket community, starting with the Nissan 240SX and SR20DET and expanding into platforms like the Nissan 350Z, BMW E36/E46, Mazda Miata, and beyond\. With decades of experience and a customer\-first approach, Enjuku continues to set the standard in performance parts and service nationwide\.
- [Frank And Oak](https://www.signifyd.com/customers/frank-and-oak/): Frank And Oak’s apparel is made to last and ensure the environment and local communities are protected\. Frank And Oak leverages Signifyd’s Commerce Protection Platform to prevent fraud and abuse, including INR chargebacks\. 

## Events
- [FLOW Summit 2025](https://www.signifyd.com/events/flow-summit-2025/): Join us in New York, April 23–24, 2025 to discover, connect and thrive at FLOW Summit 2025\! Stay ahead in digital retail at Signifyd’s annual summit, where ecommerce and fraud prevention professionals, industry leaders and innovators shape the future together\.
- [Winning the Loyalty Game: Stopping ATO \& Fraud Across Travel \& Ticketing](https://www.signifyd.com/events/stopping-ato-fraud-in-travel-ticketing/)
- [Returns Done Right: Protecting Profits While Winning Loyalty](https://www.signifyd.com/events/returns-done-right-protecting-profits-while-winning-loyalty/): Returns experts from Abercrombie \& Fitch, Back Market and AfterShip share practical advice on developing a returns strategy that drives loyalty without sacrificing margins\.
- [Women in Retail \| On the Road \- Seattle](https://www.signifyd.com/events/women-in-retail-on-the-road-seattle/): Signifyd is proud to sponsor Women in Retail: On the Road in Seattle, supporting a community of executive women leaders as they connect, share insights, and drive the future of business\.
- [Women in Retail \| On the Road \- Chicago](https://www.signifyd.com/events/women-in-retail-on-the-road-chicago/): Signifyd is proud to sponsor Women in Retail: On the Road in Chicago, supporting a community of executive women leaders as they connect, share insights, and drive the future of business\.

## Partners
- [Avalara](https://www.signifyd.com/partners/avalara/): Tax compliance is taxing\. Each jurisdiction has its own rules about what gets taxed and by how much \- and those rules are always changing\. Tax compliance is about everything from registering in the right states to filing returns, remitting taxes and maintaining proper records\.
- [VTEX](https://www.signifyd.com/partners/vtex/): The VTEX digital commerce platform enables enterprises to rapidly explore new ways to sell and fulfill products and services with an array of customization options and unprecedented speed and agility\.
- [Miva](https://www.signifyd.com/partners/miva/): The most flexible and secure ecommerce software on the market\. Build your online store today with a shopping cart platform by Miva Merchant\.
- [NetSuite](https://www.signifyd.com/partners/netsuite/): NetSuite is the leading integrated cloud business software suite, including business accounting, ERP, CRM and ecommerce software\.
- [Shopify Plus](https://www.signifyd.com/partners/shopify-plus/): The best enterprise ecommerce platform for high\-growth businesses\. See why companies making $1M\-500M are growing an average of 126% YoY on Shopify Plus — 690% above the ecommerce industry average\. Grow bigger, faster\.

## Fraud 101
- [Merchant's guide to AI\-powered fraud: What it is and how to fight it](https://www.signifyd.com/resources/fraud-101/ai-powered-fraud/)
- [Chargebacks: The different types and what they mean](https://www.signifyd.com/resources/fraud-101/types-of-chargebacks/)
- [When customer\-friendly policies become commercial risk](https://www.signifyd.com/resources/fraud-101/when-customer-friendly-policies-become-commercial-risk/)
- [What is contact rate](https://www.signifyd.com/resources/fraud-101/what-is-contact-rate/)
- [A comprehensive guide to payment fraud prevention for merchants](https://www.signifyd.com/resources/fraud-101/payment-fraud-prevention-guide/)

## News Releases
- [Signifyd Study Predicts a 5% Rise in Holiday Ecommerce This Season, as Consumers Battle Inflation and an Uncertain Economy](https://www.signifyd.com/news-releases/signifyd-study-predicts-5-rise-holiday-ecommerce-as-consumers-battle-inflation/)
- [Signifyd Launches New Product Advisory Board to Build Future of Commerce Protection with Leading Brands](https://www.signifyd.com/news-releases/signifyd-launches-new-product-to-build-future-of-commerce-protection/)
- [Signifyd to Provide Comprehensive Protection for the Entire Digital Shopping Journey on Google Cloud Marketplace](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20221011005502/en/Signifyd-to-Provide-Comprehensive-Protection-for-the-Entire-Digital-Shopping-Journey-on-Google-Cloud-Marketplace)
- [Signifyd and Adobe Partner to Make Industry\-Leading Fraud and Abuse Protection Available to Adobe Commerce Customers](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20230327005206/en/Signifyd-and-Adobe-Partner-to-Make-Industry-Leading-Fraud-and-Abuse-Protection-Available-to-Adobe-Commerce-Customers): As global leaders delivering great digital experiences, the strategic partnership between Signifyd and Adobe empowers retailers and brands to provide elevated consumer buying journeys while optimizing revenue and increasing conversion rates\.
- [Signifyd launches its Return Abuse Prevention solution, empowering retailers to provide fast and easy returns without the fear of abuse](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20210422005284/en/Signifyd-Launches-Its-Return-Abuse-Prevention-Solution-Empowering-Retailers-to-Provide-Fast-and-Easy-Returns-Without-the-Fear-of-Abuse)
